title: Micropip Test
text:
This page tests whether a Shinylive app embedded in Quarto can install a Python package using a bundled requirements.txt file.

from pyfiglet import figlet_format
from shiny import App, ui

app = App(
    ui.page_fluid(
        ui.h2("requirements.txt install test"),
        ui.p("If this page works, the package was installed inside the Shinylive runtime."),
        ui.tags.pre(figlet_format("MCQPy")),
    ),
    None,
)

title: MCQPy Web
text:
This page embeds the MCQPy Shinylive quiz app using a generated wheel-based include.
The include is produced with mcqpy_shiny.embed_cli, which emits a small Shinylive app wrapper plus a requirements.txt that installs mcqpy-shiny from a published wheel.
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
## file: app.py
from mcqpy_shiny.embed_app import create_app

app = create_app(
    fixed_url=None,
    fixed_token=None,
    allow_manual_load=True,
    title='MCQPy Quiz',
    card_width='900px',
)
